texts.en: The gravitational stability of the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system is maintained by Dark Matter emitters positioned within its asteroid belt. These emitters are controlled by a supercomputer located on the central planet. Records from this central computer suggest the entire system was an experimental site for gravity manipulation, established by an ancient civilization.
